name: Akazukin
source: [url=/c91602]Jack's[/url] upperclassman with an energetic disposition. She is a member of the discipline committee and enthusiastic about punishing students who cause trouble with her Chishiki powers; however, her powers always end up causing damage to the surroundings around her, and she's even known for being the number one in school equipment damaging.
